profile.name: Pham Hong Chang My
profile.positioning: I turn stakeholder needs into clear requirements and practical solutions.

about: I have always been a quiet person, yet I admire those who can guide conversations toward a clear purpose. Watching a Business Analyst lead a discussion during an extracurricular activity first sparked my curiosity about the role.

Since then, I have explored how Business Analysts approach projects and challenged myself to apply the same process through personal projects: engaging with potential users, uncovering their real pain points, and translating insights into requirements and practical solutions.

This journey has helped me discover the work I want to pursue: collaborating with stakeholders as a Business Analyst to understand business needs, clarify requirements, and turn them into meaningful solutions.
philosophy: Curiosity drives me to ask, listening helps me understand, and purpose guides me to make a difference.

projects.name: HiTalent
projects.coverAlt: HiTalent HR portal login interface mockup
projects.overview: A recruitment-focused web application project involving market research, stakeholder elicitation, process improvement, system requirements documentation, and UI mockup design.
contributions: Analyzed recruitment market trends and data to identify market gaps and define the project direction.
Prepared and conducted stakeholder elicitation through structured interview questions and follow-ups to identify pain points and business needs.
Analyzed AS-IS processes and stakeholder needs to propose TO-BE workflows and process improvements.
Developed BA artifacts, including 1 User Story Map, a 24-entity ERD, 10 Use Cases, 1 AS-IS BPMN diagram, and 5 TO-BE BPMN diagrams.
Documented system requirements in an SRS with 6 User Flows and 6 State Diagrams, and designed 37 UI mockup screens.

projects.name: Sân Vui – Pickleball Court Booking App
projects.coverAlt: Sân Vui registration and pickleball court booking interface mockups
projects.overview: A mobile application project focused on pickleball court booking, informed by user interviews and research into existing booking solutions.
contributions: Conducted interviews with pickleball players across different user groups to understand their behaviors, needs, and pain points, and developed user personas.
Researched and compared existing booking solutions to identify market gaps and potential opportunities.
Developed a Screen Map covering 9 main screens for the Player/Court Booker role to define the application structure and navigation flows.
Designed 17 UI mockup screens to translate user requirements and screen flows into intuitive mobile interfaces.

projects.name: Giúp việc nhanh
projects.coverAlt: Giúp việc nhanh login and home interface mockups
projects.overview: A mobile application project involving customers, helpers, and service coordinators, with a focus on analyzing user needs, improving workflows, and defining system functionalities.
contributions: Prepared stakeholder interview questions and follow-ups to elicit business needs and identify pain points.
Interviewed customers, helpers, and service coordinators to analyze user needs and develop user personas.
Analyzed interview findings to model AS-IS processes and propose TO-BE workflows with improvements and exception handling.
Developed User Flows to visualize user interactions and navigation.
Defined 9 functional modules comprising 49 functions to structure system requirements.
Created a Screen Map with 5 main screens for the Service Coordinator role.
Designed 15 UI mockup screens to visualize system functionalities.
